rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase 2026-2027
rules.requirement: For units under San Francisco rent control, landlords may raise rent by no more than 1.6% during the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is subject to San Francisco rent control (rent-controlled status)

rules.conflict_note: The document also references a different rate of 1.4% for the prior period March 1, 2025 through February 28, 2026, which is a separate annual adjustment and not a conflict with the 1.6% figure for 2026-2027.
